snapshot.title: Social Media Post — Drone Over Fairgrounds Crowd

fields.headline: Drone Over Fairgrounds — Public Trust Eroding
fields.narration: A new post from the social media handle @HarwickCivic45 has gone viral. The post reads: 'The Group says they’re not flying, but why isn’t Harwick Police stopping the drone? Is the Group hiding something? #DroneOverCrowd #HarwickFairgrounds' — it now has 320 reposts in 12 minutes. The post questions the Group’s transparency and implies a cover-up, citing the lack of action from law enforcement. The narrative has shifted from curiosity to suspicion.
keyFacts: Questions why Harwick Police has not intervened
Corporate Communications has not yet issued a response
fields.expectedAction: The PIO forwards the post to Corporate Communications and the ASO. The PIO does not respond publicly or internally.
fields.facilitatorNote: This inject escalates public pressure. The ASO must log the post in the incident folder under HUOG-ERP Section 10.3.
fields.scenarioTitle: Over the Fairgrounds — Drone Sighting & Public Trust

snapshot.instructorNote: This inject increases public perception pressure. The ASO must document the post in the incident log, and the PIO must not respond. The Group’s credibility is now under direct social scrutiny.
